title: The novel synthesis of a condensed triazine via the heterocyclization of an azo derivative and its characterization, radiolabeling and bio-evaluation
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,39988-40005
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA05853H, Paper

Wael Shehta, Doaa A. Elsayed, F. Marzook, Mohammed G. Assy, Mahmoud M. Sultan, S. El-Kalyoubi, M. Korany, Mohamed E. Abdu, Mohamed Abdel-Haleem, Mohamed Taha Yassin
New benzotriazinone derivatives were synthesized. Triazine 12 showed strong antitumor activity, low toxicity, and efficient 99mTc labeling with high tumor uptake, suggesting potential as a tumor imaging agent.
